scope: Generic five-stage image/tabular hybrid classification; independent handcrafted RGB and fused-MLP realization planned.
implemented: 31 RGB descriptors: channel moments, four-bin histograms, directional absolute differences and aspect ratio
Training-only median imputation, categorical encoding and fused StandardScaler
Binary fused MLP with dropout and label-smoothed BCE
checks: Training-only missing metadata preparation and query isolation
Unknown category handling and all-missing numeric columns
Hand smoothed BCE and analytic gradient
Dropout active during training and disabled during evaluation
limitations: Normalized RGB arrays supplied by caller; no raw-file decoding or learned visual backbone
Synthetic feature and loss checks only; no accuracy claim
